page.heading: Privacy Policy
content:
Privacy Policy

Effective Date: February 17, 2024

SMK DevLabs respects your privacy and handles your information responsibly. We collect only the data needed to operate the app, provide support, and improve the experience.

Information We Collect

We may collect account details such as email address, nickname, device identifier, and app usage information. We also collect basic technical data such as device type, operating system information, crash logs, and performance diagnostics.

How We Use It

Your information is used to create and maintain your account, provide customer support, secure the service, detect abuse, and improve product quality.

Sharing

We do not sell personal information. We may share limited information with trusted service providers that help us operate the app, such as analytics or cloud hosting providers.

Security

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your information. No internet transmission is 100% secure, but we work to protect your data.

Your Choices

You can manage your account settings, delete your account, or request information about your personal information by contacting us at privacy@smk-dev.com.
